# openwebui_ldap_server_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's LDAP server connection settings (`/api/v1/auths/admin/config/ldap/server`). This is a singleton resource; use `openwebui_ldap_config` to enable or disable LDAP authentication itself.

~> Open WebUI replaces its whole LDAP server configuration on every write, so each apply first reads the current configuration and sends it back with your configured values applied. An optional attribute you do not set keeps its current server value on first apply and its last-read (state) value afterwards; it is never reset to a default. Removing a previously-set attribute from your configuration therefore leaves the old value in place: to clear or reset it, set an explicit value (for example `app_dn = ""` and `app_dn_password = ""` for an anonymous bind). The nullable `port`, `certificate_path` and `ciphers` cannot be set back to null from Terraform once they hold a value. With `-refresh=false` the state can be out of date, so a value changed outside Terraform for an attribute you do not set is written back to its state value. The "never-configured" values quoted on each attribute are what an Open WebUI that has never saved LDAP settings (and has no `LDAP_*` environment variables) reports.

~> `app_dn_password` is stored in Terraform state. Protect your state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "ldap_bind_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "openwebui_ldap_server_config" "example" {
  label                  = "Corporate LDAP"
  host                   = "ldap.example.com"
  port                   = 636
  attribute_for_mail     = "mail"
  attribute_for_username = "uid"
  app_dn                 = "cn=svc-openwebui,ou=services,dc=example,dc=com"
  app_dn_password        = var.ldap_bind_password
  search_base            = "ou=people,dc=example,dc=com"
  search_filters         = "(objectClass=person)"
  use_tls                = true
  validate_cert          = true

  # Group synchronisation requires Open WebUI v0.11.0 or later.
  enable_group_management = true
  enable_group_creation   = false
  attribute_for_groups    = "memberOf"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address of the LDAP server. Must not be empty.
- `label` (String) Display label for the LDAP server shown on the sign-in page. Must not be empty.
- `search_base` (String) Base DN under which users are searched. Must not be empty.

### Optional

- `app_dn` (String) Distinguished name of the application (bind) account. An empty string means anonymous bind. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has an empty string.
- `app_dn_password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to bind as `app_dn`. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has an empty string. Open WebUI returns this value in plain text from its read endpoint, so it is also kept in Terraform state.
- `attribute_for_groups` (String) LDAP attribute that lists a user's group memberships. Must not be blank when `enable_group_management` is `true` (see that attribute for when this is checked). Open WebUI stores a blank value while group management is off. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `memberOf`. Added in Open WebUI v0.11.0; older releases ignore it and read it back as null, so setting it against an older server fails the apply with an inconsistent-result error.
- `attribute_for_mail` (String) LDAP attribute that holds the user's email address. Must not be empty. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `mail`.
- `attribute_for_username` (String) LDAP attribute that holds the username. Must not be empty. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `uid`.
- `certificate_path` (String) Path, on the Open WebUI server, to a CA certificate file used to verify the LDAP server. An empty string means none. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has an empty string. Once it holds a value it cannot be set back to null from Terraform; use an empty string instead.
- `ciphers` (String) TLS cipher suite string. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `ALL`.
- `enable_group_creation` (Boolean) Whether groups found in LDAP are created in Open WebUI when they do not exist. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `false`. Added in Open WebUI v0.11.0; older releases ignore it and read it back as null, so setting it against an older server fails the apply with an inconsistent-result error.
- `enable_group_management` (Boolean) Whether LDAP group membership is synchronised into Open WebUI groups. Requires a non-blank `attribute_for_groups`: when both are configured, a blank attribute is rejected at plan time; when `attribute_for_groups` is left unset and the value it would keep (from the server or state) is blank, the apply fails with an error before anything is written. Set `attribute_for_groups` explicitly whenever you enable this. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `false`. Added in Open WebUI v0.11.0; older releases ignore it and read it back as null, so setting it against an older server fails the apply with an inconsistent-result error.
- `port` (Number) LDAP server port. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `389`. Once it holds a value it cannot be set back to null from Terraform.
- `search_filters` (String) LDAP search filter applied when looking up users. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has an empty string.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Whether to connect using TLS. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `true`.
- `validate_cert` (Boolean) Whether to validate the LDAP server's TLS certificate. When unset, keeps the current server value on first apply and the last-read (state) value afterwards; a never-configured Open WebUI has `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier.
